reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "`envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_failure` -> `envoy_cilium_npds_update_failure`", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: After upgrading to 1.17 the metric formerly exposed as envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_failure is emitted as envoy_cilium_npds_update_failure, so dashboards, alerts, or other monitoring that select the old name will no longer match data for it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts, and other monitoring that reference envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_failure to use envoy_cilium_npds_update_failure.

proposed.statement: Cilium 1.17 renames the metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_failure to envoy_cilium_npds_update_failure, so monitoring that references the old name no longer matches it.
